title: Pure Voiceless Voice
summary: Voiceless Voice cards with one generic LIGHT Ritual Dragon and generic staples; the page's Diviner, Dogmatika and Branded engines are left out. Lo, the Prayers of the Voiceless Voice places Barrier of the Voiceless Voice from the Deck when summoned, Barrier searches Saffira, Dragon Queen, and Saffira discards itself to send Prayers of the Voiceless Voice and search Skull Guardian. Banished from the GY, Saffira Ritual Summons Skull Guardian by tributing Lo, and Lo can pay for a whole Ritual Summon on its own. With Lo on the field or in the GY, Skull Guardian has 4100 ATK and negates any activation. Barrier keeps your LIGHT monsters from being targeted, and Prayers summons a replacement Ritual from the Deck when one is removed. Saffira, Divine Dragon of the Voiceless Voice and Guardian of the Voiceless Voice, from 2024, are the newest cards. Sauravis, the Ancient and Ascended is the generic Ritual Dragon that Prayers names.
main: Lo, the Prayers of the Voiceless Voice
Starter: places a Voiceless Voice Continuous Spell/Trap; pays for a whole Ritual; revives itself.
Skull Guardian, Protector of the Voiceless Voice
Ritual boss: searches when summoned; negates any activation with Lo out.
Saffira, Dragon Queen of the Voiceless Voice
Discards to send a Ritual Spell and search a LIGHT Ritual; Ritual Summons from the GY.
Sauravis, Dragon Sage of the Voiceless Voice
Summons itself by shuffling Spells back; swaps in a Ritual Monster on their turn.
Saffira, Divine Dragon of the Voiceless Voice
Newest Ritual: draws 2 with Lo; discards from their hand in battle.
Sauravis, the Ancient and Ascended
Generic Ritual Dragon that Prayers names: negates targeting and Special Summons.
Prayers of the Voiceless Voice
Ritual Spell for any LIGHT Ritual; replaces one from the Deck when it is removed.
Barrier of the Voiceless Voice
Searches a Voiceless Voice card; protects LIGHT monsters from targeting.
Blessing of the Voiceless Voice
Recovers a Voiceless Voice card; Ritual Summons when a non-Ritual is summoned.
Radiance of the Voiceless Voice
Fetches a Voiceless Voice monster, or destroys a card per Ritual you control.
Guardian of the Voiceless Voice
Newest Trap: summons Skull Guardian when a monster falls.
